text: I see you're experiencing fatigue and severe itching along with abnormal liver function tests. To narrow this down, have you noticed any changes in your skin color, such as jaundice or a yellowing of the eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, diarrhea, joint pain, or recent travel. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pneumonia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is concerning; pneumonia would not typically explain severe itching or abnormal liver function tests. Given your history of ulcerative colitis, have you recently started any new medications like sulfasalazine, azathioprine, or methotrexate?

REQUEST TEST: Medication review and Liver Biopsy.
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC).

Based on the ultrasound showing thickening of the bile ducts and your history of ulcerative colitis, this strongly suggests PSC. Have you noticed any abdominal pain in the upper right quadrant or any episodes of fever or chills recently?
